title: PyRIT: A Framework for Security Risk Identification and Red Teaming in Generative AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Automated red teaming using the PyRIT framework to generate adversarial prompts (including multi-turn strategies and converters like base64 or translations) designed to elicit biased content, with model responses evaluated by LLM-based 'self-ask' scorers.

Automated red teaming using PyRIT to generate adversarial prompts designed to elicit hate speech, utilizing various attack strategies and converters, with outputs scored by custom LLM-based classifiers.
